initialization.recipe: Draw from frozen prepared priors; no baseline sampler information

initialization_s_reason: Sampler initialization/warmup not timed separately from fit

timing_definitions.initialization_s: Sampler initialization and warmup included in total_s; not separately instrumented
timing_definitions.preparation_s: Elapsed prerequisite SLaM stage fits and mass model construction after dataset setup; excludes mass fit and prepared export; shared prerequisite cost excluded from total_s; never sum across experiment rows
timing_definitions.sampling_s: Sampler-native clock; cumulative on resume where reported; scope depends on sampler
timing_definitions.total_s: Elapsed experiment search.fit call only; segment-only for resume; excludes shared prerequisite preparation and artifact validation

definitions.effective_sample_size: No common posterior ESS estimator instrumented; terminal SMC weight ESS is not substituted
definitions.gradient_evaluations: Not instrumented; neither iterations nor particle counts are gradient counts
definitions.iterations: Sampler-native Emcee steps aggregated over synchronized walkers or SMC tempering steps; includes native warmup where reported; cumulative on resume
definitions.likelihood_evaluations: Nautilus total_samples counts rejected and accepted likelihood calls, including exploration; other samplers not instrumented
definitions.retained_samples: Length of PyAutoFit returned sample list after sampler-native burn-in/filtering; cumulative on resume
